prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, finish copy/layout, home layout, sign_in hint/layout/redesign).
Redesigning adoption screens (adoption, redesign) is helpful and delivered multiple winning tests.
Copy changes on the path selection screen (choose_path, copy) consistently hurt performance.
Adding new screens at the finish step (finish, new_screen) showed no positive effect and hurt performance.
Notification toggles (home, notification), waiting screen info (home, wait_info), waiting redesigns (home, redesign), and finish hints (finish, hint) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently higher than the noise-corrected measured results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive pet preview screen before adoption certificate: Insert a pet preview screen right before adoption certificate to verify pet animations and visual appearance before finalizing. (why: Support receives multiple reports of pet creation visual bugs or unexpected output. A preview step lets users verify before continuing.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Split layout redesign for photo upload screen: Redesign the custom pet photo upload screen with a split layout pairing the photo picker with clear visual framing. (why: Adoption screen redesigns consistently perform well. Photo upload mean time is high during adoption step.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder sign-in screen after adoption certificate completion: Move the sign-in step to occur right after the adoption certificate screen, letting users complete pet creation before account sign-in. (why: Sign-in conversion is 76.0%. Letting users build emotional investment in their pet first increases sign-in completion.)
3: [adoption, new_screen] Pet personality quiz screen during adoption: Add a pet personality questionnaire screen during adoption to customize companion temperament. (why: Adoption step engagement screens drive positive onboarding conversion and lower early drop-off.)
4: [sign_in, incentive] Cloud pet backup assurance badge on sign-in screen: Add a prominent cloud backup badge on the sign-in screen assuring users that sign-in saves and protects pet progress. (why: Top support theme (8 emails) reports pets missing or reset after sign-in. Explaining cloud sync directly addresses account fears.)
5: [finish, redesign] Spotlight layout redesign for home intro launch screen: Redesign home_intro screen to a focused spotlight layout centered on launching the pet directly to the desktop. (why: The final onboarding step has the lowest conversion rate (64.8%) and longest mean time (5815s). A clear spotlight layout speeds launch.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Mascot intro centered layout on initial story screen: Change story screen layout to centered layout featuring an animated welcoming mascot component. (why: Mean time on the first step is very high (514s). A centered layout with mascot focuses user attention quickly.)
7: [home, hint] Desktop launch troubleshooting hint on waiting screen: Display a hint on the waiting screen explaining how to locate the pet in system tray if it fails to show on desktop automatically. (why: Support received 3 bug reports about pets failing to show on desktop or app stalling during setup.)
8: [finish, hint] Desktop control hint on onboarding finish screen: Add an explicit control hint on the home_intro screen teaching users how to interact with and control their new desktop pet. (why: Support mail contains confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the desktop pet after setup.)

scores.note: Adding a new flow step increases friction despite support feedback about pet previews.
Adoption redesigns consistently yield strong positive lift and address high step mean time.
Reordering sign-in has weak evidence and previously resulted in neutral conversion change.
Adding extra questionnaire screens adds setup friction and hurts funnel completion.
Directly resolves top support complaint about account progress loss with simple UI addition.
Finish step has the highest dropoff rate (35.2%); layout focus can help streamline completion.
Choose_path has high baseline conversion and historical path changes tend to perform poorly.
Low cost hint addresses specific tray icon support tickets during waiting step.
Finish hints showed +2.9% measured lift and target the lowest conversion step in the funnel.
